summary: Read-only audit complete: CONFIRMED root cause is registered MCP argument overloading, not wrong JobManager authorization. AssignTask agentId names the target, but global ingress takes agentId as initiating actor; transport and promotion faithfully register that target as job owner. This also affects other legacy admin target-as-agentId routes and potentially misattributes activity/alerts. The administrative ledger actor is separately AuthenticatedUser (or historical receipt actor); preserve it. No source changes, no target impersonation, no replay, no production mutation. Proposed narrow actor/subject schema correction below; Lead owns task sequencing.
